about.frozen: Committed before any replay code reads real data. Nothing in this file may change after the first replay run (ADR 0005, ADR 0030). Gate Results cite this file's sha256.
about.title: Pre-registered gates for the 2026 election-night projection

arrival_orders.orders_rationale: Set by Monte Carlo noise and compute time, never by score (#6), and chosen before any replay ran (#23, Alex, 2026-10-08). Compute (INFERRED from #6's per-projection estimate): mayor is 4 nights x 19 checkpoints x 60 orders = 4,560 projections per variant at about 1 s each, about 76 core-minutes, and about three times that for count-only, forecast-weighted and shifted-forecast together (about 25 minutes on 10 cores); council and trustee are faster. Noise (INFERRED, not measured: no replay may run before this file is frozen): the effective sample for a pass/fail gate is close to the number of nights (research 03), so the noise from orders, falling as 1/sqrt(20) per pattern, is taken to be second-order to the between-night variation. 30 and 120 per night were the alternatives considered.

seeds.derivation: numpy.random.SeedSequence(root, spawn_key=(year, kind_index, order_index)); kind_index follows the order of kinds: 0 early, 1 interleaved, 2 late, 3 ward_clustered, 4 size_largest_first, 5 size_smallest_first
seeds.projection_draws: seeded as on the night, from both Count Snapshot seqs and the model version (#17 Payload: a pure function of the Count Snapshot pair and the Night Bundle)

size_largest_first.rule: election-day units by final total votes, largest first; ties in uniformly random order

size_smallest_first.rule: election-day units by final total votes, smallest first; ties in uniformly random order

ward_clustered.rule: wards in uniformly random order; each ward's election-day units contiguous, in uniformly random order within the ward

arrival_orders.unit_of_order: subdivision; one simulated order per night, shared across offices

ward_aggregates.block: each Ward Aggregate (one ward, one code) enters as one block

timing_patterns.early: all blocks before any election-day unit, in uniformly random order among themselves
timing_patterns.interleaved: each block at a uniformly random position among the election-day units
timing_patterns.late: each block at a uniformly random position after 85% of election-day units (counted by units), as in 2023

baseline.name: Tally Baseline
baseline.rule: counted shares taken as final, with the current leader winning for certain

checkpoints.rule: each race is scored at the first Count Snapshot at or after each point of its own Reporting Progress

fitting.rule: parameters are re-fitted for each replayed night with that night left out (ADR 0029)

forecast_density.estimator: Gaussian KDE over the forecast's margin draws
forecast_density.evaluated_at: each count-only draw's own final margin between that pair
forecast_density.pair: the forecast's own top two by win probability (each draw's largest named share wins; ties to the earlier candidate), production's pairwise_margin rule
forecast_density.quantity: the forecast's signed leader-minus-challenger margin, in points of the full ballot

ess_fallback.below: that refresh uses count-only, or the tally if count-only failed its gate; no hysteresis (#17 Mayor's forecast-weighted variant, from #9)
ess_fallback.report: how often the mayor card would switch
ess_fallback.statistic: Kish effective sample size of the forecast weights

historical_forecasts.source: data/forecasts/holdout-1d (S4: production compact model, production-path holdout driver)

ladder: the variant goes live only if it meets criteria 1-6, the wrong-forecast stress test, and beats count-only on total margin CRPS and on 3 of 4 nights, both on the same orders and draws
otherwise count-only stands if it meets criteria 1-6
forecast_weighted_variant.rule: the count-only draws, each weighted by the final Mayoral Forecast's density at that draw (forecast_density)

wrong_forecast_stress_test.shift: stress_test_shift.shift_points, applied to every forecast margin draw against the eventual winner

gate_result.compute: a smoke trial with a hard timeout first; its extrapolation is shown to Alex before the full run
holds: the model version (a hash of the code plus the frozen parameters)
gate_result.night_checks: no Mandatory Sensitivity Variants and no Band Stability Gate; runtime integrity failures remain fail-closed (ADR 0032)
gate_result.on_fail: the whole level shows the tally only; a level is never split after the scores are in; no Reporting Progress floor
gate_result.reruns: after the first run the scoring rules, baseline, thresholds and replay protocol are frozen; the model may change only to fix a defect, each with a failing test and a written reason that doesn't cite replay scores; every Gate Result is kept and reported, with the number of runs

exclusions: Conseil scolaire Viamonde and MonAvenir (no projection; tally only)

mayor.note: 2014 runs on its 44 wards; 2023 is the by-election for mayor

criteria.name: margin CRPS beats the Tally Baseline in total
criteria.rule: total signed-margin CRPS < Tally Baseline total absolute margin error
criteria.weighting: nights equally; races equally within a night

criteria.name: margin CRPS beats the Tally Baseline in a majority of nights
criteria.rule: per-night signed-margin CRPS < per-night Tally Baseline absolute margin error

criteria.name: winner Brier not worse
criteria.rule: total multiclass Brier <= Tally Baseline total multiclass Brier
criteria.weighting: nights equally; races equally within a night

criteria.name: G1, confident calls
criteria.rule: among candidates given win probability >= 0.95, the share who win >= 0.95
criteria.weighting: within a night, every (race, checkpoint, order) case is pooled into one rate; the per-night rates are averaged with nights weighted equally (#23, Alex, 2026-10-08); a night with no case at 0.95 or more is left out of the average

criteria.name: G2, ranges
criteria.rule: the central 90% range contains the final value at least 85% of the time, for the signed margin and for each candidate's final share
criteria.weighting: within a night, every (race, checkpoint, order) case is pooled into one rate; the per-night rates are averaged with nights weighted equally (#23, Alex, 2026-10-08); the margin and the per-candidate shares are each held to 0.85 separately

criteria.name: the Bailão check
criteria.rule: at 2023 20:26 (the real ward-by-ward capture), in the fold fitted without 2023, Ana Bailão's win probability < 0.65 (at most 'about 6 in 10', ADR 0006)

pass_criteria.threshold_kind: fixed numbers, not a t-bound (ADR 0041 not used)

real_captures.rule: named checkpoints, pooled with the simulated checkpoints; reported, not an extra gate

scores.baseline_comparator: the Tally Baseline's absolute signed-margin error (its CRPS, a point mass)
scores.primary: CRPS of the signed margin of the eventual winner over the eventual runner-up, in points; negative in draws where the order is reversed

stress_test_shift.applied_as: a location shift of every forecast margin draw against the eventual winner
stress_test_shift.rule: 90th percentile (linear interpolation) of the absolute errors in the 1-day held-out forecasts' median leader-minus-challenger margin, over all seven historical campaigns; leader and challenger are the forecast's top two by win probability

ladder: a ward table, if one was released before the night
else the citywide figure, split by historical ward shares

2014.publisher: The Globe and Mail, reporting City figures

ward_aggregate_paths.press_reports_count: yes: a dated pre-election report of the City's figure counts as released (#23, Alex, 2026-10-08), as for 2018
